vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: sholat
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle is designed to fetch prayer schedules from the public API `api.myquran.com`. The `SKILL.md` provides clear, benign instructions for using the included Python script or direct `curl` commands, without any evidence of prompt injection attempts. The `scripts/myquran_sholat.py` script uses only standard Python libraries, makes HTTP requests exclusively to `https://api.myquran.com/v3`, and safely handles user input by URL-encoding parameters, preventing malicious execution or data exfiltration.
